title: Distance from strike
description: How far the live BTC price sits from this round's strike, as a signed gap in basis points. Positive means BTC is above the strike and Up is winning; negative means Down is.

delta_bps.label: Gap (bps)
delta_bps.description: Spot minus strike, as a share of the strike, in basis points. One basis point is a hundredth of a percent, so 25 means BTC is 0.25% above the line.
